content: Phawuloosi Yuushoy Abban Teqetida Biitta Maltan
Nuuni gaxa saro keyida wode gakida bessay yuushoy abban teqetida biitta, Malta gideysa erida.
Malta asay nuus daro keeha keehidosona. Iri bukiya gishonne meegiya gisho tama eethidi nuna ubbaa mokidosona.
Phawuloosi daro afira shiishidi taman wothishin, shooshi seela gisho keyidi iya kushiya bolla xaaxetidi iya dukis.
Malta asay shooshi Phawuloosa kushen xaaxetidaysa be7ida wode issoy issuwako, “Tuma ha uray shempo wodhida asi; hari attoshin abbaafe I attinka xoossa pirdafe
attidi paxa daanaw danda7ibeenna” yaagidosona.
Shin Phawuloosi ba kushiyape shooshaa wuxarkidi, taman yeggis; iya aykoka qohibeenna.
Enti, “Iya asatethay kixees, woyko akeekona kundidi hayqees” gidi iya naagoosona. Shin daro wode naagidi iya asatethan aybika dummatidabay dhayin, “Hessi xoosse” yaagidi banta qofaa laammidosona.
He heeran yuushoy abban teqetida biitta halaqaa, Pupliyoosa geeteteysas gadey de7ees; heedzu gallas gakanaw I nuna siiqon mokis.
Pupliyoosa aaway qoxo, mishanne ulo uttison hargetidi zin7idi de7ees. Phawuloosi iya soo gelidi iyaw Xoossaa woossis; ba kushiya iya bolla wothidi pathis.
Hessafe guye, yuushoy abban teqetida biitta, Maltan de7iya hargiya hara asatika yidi paxidosona.
Enti nuna daro boncho bonchidosona; nuuni markaben baanaw dendida wode oges koshshiyaba nuus immidosona.
Phawuloosi Roome Gakis
Heedzu ageenape guye, Maltan balgo aathidi Markaben gelidi Iskindire baanaw dendida. He markabiya bolla Diyosqoroosa geetetiya mente eeqata misiley de7ees.
Sirakuuse katamaa gelidi yan heedzu gallas uttida.
Yaape dendidi Regiyume katamaa gakida. Issi gallasape guye, dugeha bagga carkoy carkin, wontetha gallas Putiyoola katamaa gakida.
Yan nuuni issi issi ammaniya asata demmin, bantara saaminta gam7ana mela nuna woossidosona. Hessafe guye, Roome bida.
Roomen de7iya ammaniya asati nubaa si7idi, Afiyoosa Giyan, Heedzu Imatha Keethi gakanaw nuna mokanaw yidosona. Phawuloosi enta be7ida wode Xoossaa galatidi minetis.
Nuuni Roome gelida wode Phawuloosi bana naagiya wotaadariyara barka de7o geetetis.

Heedzu gallasape guye, Phawuloosi Ayhudeta halaqata baako xeegisis. Enti shiiqida wode entako, “Ta ishato, taani nu asaa woyko nu aawata wogaa bolla aybi qohoka oothabike, shin tana Yerusalaamen qachidi Roome asaas aathidi immidosona.
Enti ta mootuwa be7idi hayqos gathiyaba ta bolla aybibaaka demmiboonna gisho tana billanaw qopidosona.
Shin Ayhudeti hessa ixida wode, ‘Tabaa Qeesarey pirdo’ yaagasipe attishin, taani ta deriya mootiyabay de7in gidenna.
Taani hintena xeegisiday hintena be7anawunne hintew haysa odanaasa. Taani ha santhalaatan qashetiday Isra7eele asay naagiya ufaysaa gishosa” yaagis.
Ayhude halaqati Phawuloosako, “Nuus Yihudape nebaa xaafetida dabdaabey gakibeenna. Yaape yida asatape issoyka nebaa iita odiday baawa.
Shin ha ne kaalliya ammanuwa dumma dumma bessan asay ixeysa nuuni eriya gisho ne qofaa si7anaw koyoos” yaagidosona.

Enti banta yaana gallas Phawuloosas qaxaridi, he gallas daridi I de7iyasuwa yidosona. I wontafe omarsi gakanaw Xoossaa kawotethaaba entaw markatis. Qassi enti Yesuusaba ammanana mela Muse higgiyafenne nabeta maxaafape qoncisidi enta tamaarsis.
Issoti issoti Phawuloosi gidaysa ammanidosona, shin harati ammanibookona.
Enti banta giddon oda ma7onna ixida wode Phawuloosi issiba gidaape guye bidosona. I haysada yaagis: “Geeshsha Ayyaanay nu aawatas nabiya Isayaasa doonan odidaysi tuma.

content.text: hinte sissi si7eeta, shin hintew gelenna;
Ayis giiko, ha deriya wozanay muumis;
Hessi bayneko, enti banta ayfiyan be7idi,
banta haythan si7idi, banta wozanan akeekidi,

content: “Hiza, haysi Xoossaa atotetha kiitay Ayhude gidonaysatas gideysa ereeta. Entika si7ana” yaagis.
Phawuloosi hessa gidaape guye, Ayhudeti banta giddon daro palamishe keyidi bidosona.
Phawuloosi kera keethan nam7u laythi kumethi de7is; yan de7ishe baako yaa ubbaa mokees.
Yashshi baynanne oonika diggonashin Xoossa kawotethaaba sabbakis; Godaa Yesuus Kiristoosaba qoncisidi tamaarsees.

footnotes.text: Xoossa pirdafe: He wode he biittan dumma dumma macca xoossati de7oosona. Entafe issiniya iita oothiya asaa pirdiyaro. Iya pirda xoossi geeteta xeegetasu.
